name: Eritrea
description: Eritrea from Aksum and the Red Sea coast to Italian rule, federation with Ethiopia, a thirty-year war, independence in 1993 and a closed state.

checkpoints.name: Aksum and the coast
checkpoints.note: Adulis was the port of Aksum. Ethiopian kings, Ottomans and Egyptians later held parts of the land.

checkpoints.name: Italian Eritrea
checkpoints.note: Italy made Eritrea its first colony and built Asmara. Britain ran it from 1941.

checkpoints.name: War for freedom
checkpoints.note: Eritrea was joined to Ethiopia, and a thirty-year war for independence began in 1961.

checkpoints.name: Independent Eritrea
checkpoints.note: Eritrea became independent in 1993. After a border war with Ethiopia it became one of the world's most closed states.
